scope: Rear cloth reserve and natural hair exits; accepted247 front protected
selection: pashminaHairFamilies[build][hair] selects family; pashminaVariants[build][family][top] selects cloth. fits[build-hair].pashmina.hair selects the covered hairstyle. Compare247 switches cloth and covered hair together. No extra profile bits or runtime physics.
coordinates: Shared coordinates and component transforms retained. Only Blender Z-up to glTF Y-up conversion.
materials: Independent roles/colors and lens/frame materials retained; opaque woven cloth, linear sheen0.12; ordinary uncompressed/unquantized GLBs.
hair: Covered-only authored variants. Concealed old crowns remain inside the hood; visible loose/braid lengths are new continuous paths. Uncovered hair and other headwear fits are unchanged.
sources: Both default assemblies are packed. fit248.py starts from preserved247 per-top sources and235/224 authoring helpers. Per-fit native sources remain in the local authoring directory.
camera: 120/512 portraits share exact framing; fixtures248.json records studio, camera, exposure and color management.
depth: Old portrait color/depth pairs must not be reused for changed geometry. See depth248.json for matched assembly depth references; native layer-composition baking remains separate.
qualification: Source/export/browser artwork review only; no native/mobile performance qualification or production-repository changes.
